nodes.notes: Fires every day at 19:00 in the n8n instance's timezone. Set timezone to Europe/London in n8n settings.

parameters.prompt:
You are reviewing an email received by Better Call Wes (a sole-trader plumbing & heating business in Southampton, UK). Decide whether this email represents a COST TO THE BUSINESS that should be sent to bookkeeping (Dext).

Forward = TRUE when the email is:
- A supplier invoice (Screwfix, BES, Plumb Center, City Plumbing, Wolseley, Toolstation, etc.)
- A purchase receipt (fuel, tools, materials, parking, software subscriptions)
- A subscription / SaaS billing receipt (Google, Microsoft, Coolify, ServiceM8, Meta ads, GoHighLevel, etc.)
- A utility / service bill for the business (van insurance, phone, public liability)
- An order confirmation from a supplier IF it includes a price/total

Forward = FALSE when the email is:
- A customer invoice the BUSINESS sent OUT (revenue, not cost)
- Marketing, newsletters, promotions
- Quote requests, lead enquiries, customer messages
- Personal mail
- Bank statements, HMRC notices (handled separately)
- Delivery tracking with no price
- Anything ambiguous or non-financial

Email to classify:
From: {{ $json.senderName }} <{{ $json.senderEmail }}>
Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Has attachments: {{ $json.hasAttachments }}
Body preview: {{ $json.bodyPreview }}

Respond with strict JSON only, no markdown:
{"is_cost_doc": true|false, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "supplier": "name or null", "amount_gbp": number or null, "reason": "one short sentence"}
